positions.name: PipelineVocabularyAsRegister
positions.frame: How does native pipeline-engineering vocabulary perform the document's technical register across both description and directive?
positions.why: Both expressions deploy domain vocabulary natively — 'missing-id failure pattern,' '## level heading, no id field,' 'valid slug' — without adapting for a non-technical audience, establishing a single technical register signature. The set holds a conviction gradient in tension: src-1 is a flat claim about what the test does (present, realis), while src-2 is a settled decision-level requirement (future, irrealis, deontic 'must'). The frame reads both through the shared register performance rather than resolving the modal difference.
